Kaqili Soft Mist Lipgloss – Velour Air Lip Glaze, Lightweight Matte Finish, Long-Lasting Hydration & Smooth Texture – Shades 1, 2, 3, 4

Kaqili Soft Mist Lipgloss delivers a velvety, lightweight finish with a soft matte effect that enhances your natural beauty. Designed with a velour air glaze formula, this lipgloss provides smooth application, rich color payoff, and long-lasting wear. Available in Shades 1, 2, 3, and 4, it offers versatile options for everyday elegance or bold statement looks. Its nourishing texture keeps lips hydrated and comfortable without feeling heavy or sticky. Perfect for daily use, parties, or special occasions, Kaqili Lipgloss is a must-have addition to any makeup collection.
Key Features:
Kaqili Soft Mist Velour Air Lip Glaze for a soft matte finish
Available in 4 versatile shades: 1, 2, 3, and 4
Lightweight, non-sticky, and smooth texture
Rich color payoff with long-lasting wear
Hydrating formula keeps lips soft and moisturized
Ideal for casual, professional, and party makeup looks
